cases.title: Select guidance for a filtered batch bug fix

development-plan.request: Fix a filtered batch routine that updates only the first matching record.
development-plan.root-cause: The routine calls FindFirst and updates the current record without entering an enumerator loop.
proposed-changes: Iterate the supplied filtered record set and update every selected entry.
Add a regression test with multiple selected entries.
development-plan.test-strategy: Establish a red test where only one of several selected records is updated, then require all selected records to be updated after the fix.
acceptance-criteria: The regression test demonstrates red-to-green behavior.
